comment: Upstream vendored suites selected for the G-PORT port-conformance gate (W01). File paths are relative to the repository src/ root and cover the three vendored roots: third_party/pi-mono (packages/*), third_party/chord, third_party/pi-durable (upstream packages/durable; chord/pi-durable pin provenance: third_party/pi-durable/MINIMAX_CHANGES.md). Selection rule: offline, deterministic suites that run through the closure aliases (vitest runner) or the upstream node:test runner (tui). Coverage and drift are governed by `inventory` (frozen corpus at `pin`): every vendored test file is selected here or excluded with a verified reason there, and the gate fails closed when the vendored trees and the freeze disagree. Differential behavior/transcript/wire checks join the gate with the waves that own those surfaces (W02-W06).

inventory.comment: Frozen upstream test corpus at the vendored pin (reproducible test corpus freeze, plan :673). Every file in `files` must be selected in `suites` or covered by exactly one `exclusions` prefix (longest prefix wins; an exact path is a valid prefix). The gate fails closed on drift: a test file on disk missing from this freeze (new upstream test after a vendor rebaseline), a frozen file missing from disk, or a frozen file that is neither selected nor excluded all fail the gate. `pin` is machine-checked against every vendored root that carries .minimax-vendor.json.

exclusions.reason: Bun process-lifetime cases require Bun >= 1.4 (local Bun 1.3.14 exits the fixture before the exit line; reproduced on fixtures/worker-process-exit.ts on 2026-10-23). Node cases of the file run in the codemode suite selection.
Require the compiled upstream Rust env daemon (npm run build:daemon -> daemon/target/debug/pi-env, absent from the offline W01 closure) and SSH remotes. Arrives with the W08 env integration.

The package tsconfig extends the upstream monorepo root (../../tsconfig.json), which is not vendored (verified: vitest TSConfckParseError), and the harness resolves real model selection (PI_PROVIDER/PI_MODEL). Full evals execution is W11.
Provider wire/auth suites outside the selected offline leaves; product wire regressions run in their first-party suites. This exclusion does not imply every remaining upstream test needs credentials.

Upstream coding-agent suites run against the agent-session/harness runtime, the built release bundle and its asset registry (upstream `vitest --run` package script). The vendored closure compiles the package, but product integration and differential suites arrive with W02-W04.
The product TUI stays on our own 0.84.2 engine fork until the W09 rebase; the selected node-test leaf suites are upstream-pure. Editor/input/program integration suites return with W09.

Cross-tree relative import `../../telemetry/src/testing/index.ts` assumes the upstream monorepo layout (packages/chord beside packages/telemetry); our vendored root third_party/chord renames the path, so resolution fails (verified: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND). Resolution-only exclusion; the vendored telemetry tree itself is covered by the telemetry suite.
Same cross-tree `../../telemetry/...` layout mismatch as telemetry-sqlite.test.ts (verified: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND).

Cross-tree relative import `../../ai/src/api/openai-codex-responses.ts` + `../../ai/test/oauth.ts` assumes the upstream layout (packages/durable beside packages/ai); our root third_party/pi-durable renames the path (verified: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND). The file is also a live-provider e2e by design.
Same cross-tree `../../ai/...` layout mismatch as provider-session-cache-e2e.test.ts (verified: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND); live-provider e2e by design.
Requires the Cloudflare Workers test runtime (`cloudflare:test` / `cloudflare:workers`, vitest-pool-workers) which this offline closure does not provide (verified: package not found).
Same Cloudflare Workers test-runtime requirement as test-workers/storage.test.ts (verified: `cloudflare:test` not found).

Application, bundler, process reload and UI integration tests need built upstream workspace packages for spawned processes (upstream vitest.config.ts). MCode uses core host/link/state/SQLite, selected separately.
